questions.question_text: Which value CANNOT represent the probability of an event?
If P(E) = 0.35, then probability of complementary event P(not E) is:
A card is drawn from a standard deck of 52 cards. Find probability of drawing (i) a face card, (ii) a red Ace.
Two fair coins are tossed simultaneously. Find probability of getting at most 1 head.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
Sample space S = {HH, HT, TH, TT}, n(S) = 4.
At most 1 head = {HT, TH, TT}, n(E) = 3.
P(E) = 3/4.

questions.question_text: A bag contains 5 red, 8 white, and 7 black balls. A ball is drawn at random. Find P(Red), P(White), and P(Not Black).
Two unbiased dice are rolled together. Find probability that: (a) Sum is 8, (b) Sum is a prime number, (c) Doublets appear.

A dartboard is a square of side 20 cm containing a target circle of radius 7 cm.
(i) Calculate square area and circle target area. (2 Marks)
(ii) Calculate geometric probability of hitting target circle. (2 Marks)
